tooltip.polen.princess_seal.line1: The rightful seal of Princess Polen.
tooltip.polen.princess_seal.line2: It still carries the scent of royal honey.
tooltip.polen.princess_letter.line1: A letter written in shaky handwriting.
tooltip.polen.polen_journal.line1: The private journal of Princess Polen.
tooltip.polen.polen_journal.line2: Some pages are stained with honey.
dialogue.polen.chapter1.line1: Polen: H-hi... have you seen my mother?
dialogue.polen.chapter1.line2: Polen: I am not queen yet. I am just... well, the princess.
dialogue.polen.chapter1.line3: Polen: The bees keep looking at me like they expect something important.
dialogue.polen.chapter1.line4: Polen: If we are going to rebuild the kingdom, maybe we should start with somewhere safe.
